data.body: CI on prior push caught 17 held-out registry/baseline failures I hadn't run locally. Root causes + fixes: (1) 462d adds 2 ensure units -> existing drift-matrix + fsck_ensures tests hardcoded 6-unit counts and the ensure-id set; updated ALL_UNITS to include projects-seed/projects-compat-stamp and 6->8 count strings (test-only, in 462d). (2) cef7's composer split lowered edit_core complexity below its ceiling -> stale=1; ran check_complexity_baseline.py --update-stale to ratchet composer.py::edit_core 21->20 (a LOWERING, allowed by the baseline LOCK gate) so the committed-baseline unit tests pass clean; folded into cef7. Verified: 220 affected tests pass, full tests/interfaces/store green except the known local-env git-128 flake (test_tracker_config_e2e, passes on CI), lint+format+complexity(stale=0) clean, no src/rebar >800. Re-amended both (Change-Ids preserved) and re-pushed: cef7=1749 PS4, 462d=1754 PS3.
